On top of Monaco's Lamine Camara and Roma's Manu Kone , they are also looking at midfield options in the Premier League. Chelsea's plan is to bring in one midfielder if Enzo Fernandez, who has made it clear that he wants to make the move to Manchester City, leaves. Talks are ongoing over City's move for the Argentina international , but Chelsea will only do business on a replacement if they feel it improves their squad. messages.text: Why is Antonelli taking grid penalties on home soil in Italy?

metadata.summary: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli is highly unlikely to be in contention for victory on home soil at this weekend's Italian Grand Prix.
metadata.content: Kimi Antonelli: Why is Mercedes driver taking grid penalties at Italian Grand Prix in Monza on home soil? | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Kimi Antonelli: Why is Mercedes driver taking grid penalties at Italian Grand Prix in Monza on home soil? Kimi Antonelli could lose ground in the championship this weekend as he will start from the back in Sunday's Italian Grand Prix; watch every session of the Italian GP live on Sky Sports, starting with Friday's practice sessions at 11.30am and 3pm Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Friday 28 August 2026 12:58, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Speaking on The F1 Show podcast, Bernie Collins believes Mercedes have 'front-loaded' their upgrades following Toto Wolff admitting his team 'haven't got the money' to match their rivals' upgrades Championship leader Kimi Antonelli is highly unlikely to be in contention for victory on home soil at this weekend's Italian Grand Prix. Antonelli will start at the back of the grid as he will exceed the limit of four power units that can be used in a season before incurring grid penalties. It means the Mercedes driver could see his 59-point lead over team-mate George Russell and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton cut significantly, while a third consecutive win for McLaren's Lando Norris could enable the reigning world champion to make major inroads into his 83-point deficit to Antonelli.
